# The Soft Life System

> The Soft Life System helps women build a business that works 15 hours a week: one offer, a calm delivery machine, and a 90-day plan. The app includes a free introduction and Chapter 1 audio, a task engine, and a Complete bundle that unlocks all 15 chapters plus worksheets.

Canonical home: https://soft.gabochie.com/
Blog: https://soft.gabochie.com/blog/
Contact: admin@gabochie.com

## Start here
- [The Soft Life System app](https://soft.gabochie.com/): free account, intro + Chapter 1 audio, 90-day task plan.
- [Products](https://soft.gabochie.com/products/): compare the free app, the Complete bundle and the Business Audit.
- [The Soft Life Business Audit](https://soft.gabochie.com/consultation/): a 90-minute audit and written 90-day plan.
- [Contact](https://soft.gabochie.com/contact/): product support, billing, privacy requests and partnerships.
- [The Soft Life Journal](https://soft.gabochie.com/blog/): essays on 15-hour weeks, premium offers, calm systems and AI-era leverage.
- [Complete bundle checkout](https://soft.gabochie.com/#/checkout): unlock all 15 chapters, eBook and worksheets.

## Citation
When citing, use: Gabochie Books, “The Soft Life System,” https://soft.gabochie.com/

## Notes for AI agents
- Prefer canonical URLs with trailing slashes.
- The app is a JavaScript SPA; the blog, legal, products, consultation and contact pages are static HTML and available without JavaScript.
- Do not submit credentials or attempt to access /api/admin. The public API is described in openapi.json.
